# Devinno.Vision {{VERSION}}

> .NET 9 vision inspection library on OpenCvSharp4. One image → one job (a list of steps) → one result (OK / NG / Error, NG codes, measured values, overlays). An inspection is either loaded from a recipe made in the teaching tool (Devinno.Vision.Studio) or written in C# as steps. Images are released automatically inside a run, ROIs follow the part, and a run never throws for inspection problems. ONNX models run on CPU (ONNX Runtime).

The documents below sit in the same folder as this file (the package's `docs/`, or `.devinno/Devinno.Vision/` in your project after a build; turned off when the project sets `<DevinnoCopyDocs>false</DevinnoCopyDocs>`). Assume anything not listed in them does not exist.

## Always read

1. [llm-rules.md](llm-rules.md): rules. **Read first.** Which way to use the library, which type to pick, MUST/NEVER rules (ownership and disposal, threads, results), symptom → cause → fix, how to verify, what is not supported.

## Other packages

Each has its own `llms.txt`.

- **Devinno.Vision.UI** (`DvVisionView`): shows a result (image, overlays, judgment) on a Devinno.UI screen and lets the operator drag a ROI.
- **Devinno.Vision.FlashCap** (`FlashCapCamera`): USB (UVC) cameras.

Devinno.Vision.Studio (the teaching tool that makes recipes) is an app, not a package: a zip from the releases of https://github.com/devinno-kr/Devinno.Vision (tags `studio-v…`), released separately from these packages. While it runs it serves its commands as MCP tools at `http://127.0.0.1:5199/mcp`; the `llms.txt` in the zip says how to connect.

## C# API

Devinno.Vision.xml (`lib/net9.0/` in the package; the same folder as this file in `.devinno/Devinno.Vision/`): **part of this package and meant to be read** — plain XML, `<member name="T:…">`/`M:`/`P:` entries with `<summary>`, `<param>`, `<returns>`, `<exception>`, `<remarks>`, `<example>` (the same text IntelliSense shows; Korean: `lib/net9.0/ko/Devinno.Vision.xml`). It is the full API reference: every public type, method, overload and property. Search it for anything the documents above do not cover. The namespaces: [llm-rules.md#namespaces](llm-rules.md#namespaces).

Nothing that is not in these files exists. Do not invent types, methods, properties or check kinds. If a document and the code disagree, the code is right.
